recovery.ambiguousCommit: Inspect actual schema, row inventories and transaction/version receipts before retry; no blind replay
recovery.afterCommit: Reviewed forward repair or verified backup/restore with reconciliation of later committed domain/idempotency/outbox/job effects. No automatic production rollback
